items.title: Dua jenis vault
items.body: Azure Backup menyimpan data di vault, dan jenisnya ada dua. Recovery Services vault melindungi VM (virtual machine) Azure, SQL (Structured Query Language) Server dan SAP HANA di VM, Azure Files, dan server on-premises lewat agen MARS (Microsoft Azure Recovery Services), MABS (Microsoft Azure Backup Server), atau DPM (Data Protection Manager). Vault ini juga dipakai Azure Site Recovery. Backup vault melindungi Azure Disks, Azure Blobs, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, dan Kubernetes. Jenis resource yang dilindungi menentukan vault-nya.
keyPoints: Recovery Services vault: VM, Files, on-premises, Site Recovery
Backup vault: Disks, Blobs, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes

items.prompt: Sort each workload to the vault that protects it.

items.text: SQL (Structured Query Language) Server in an Azure VM

items.explanation: VM (virtual machine), file share, dan SQL (Structured Query Language) Server di VM memakai Recovery Services vault. Managed disk, blob, dan PostgreSQL memakai Backup vault.

items.prompt: You must back up Azure managed disks with Azure Backup. Which vault should you create?
options: A storage account with GRS (geo-redundant storage)
items.explanation: Azure Disks dilindungi Backup vault. Recovery Services vault dipakai untuk VM (virtual machine), Azure Files, dan workload on-premises.

items.prompt: You must back up the folders of an on-premises Windows server with the MARS (Microsoft Azure Recovery Services) agent. Where are the backups stored?
items.explanation: Agen MARS (Microsoft Azure Recovery Services) mengirim backup ke Recovery Services vault.

items.prompt: Azure Site Recovery replicates VMs (virtual machines) by using a Backup vault.
items.explanation: Salah. Site Recovery memakai Recovery Services vault, sama seperti backup VM (virtual machine).

items.title: Region dan replikasi vault
items.body: Untuk backup VM (virtual machine), vault harus berada di region yang sama dengan VM, jadi setiap region yang punya VM butuh vault sendiri. VM dan vault boleh beda subscription selama satu tenant. Vault bisa dipindah ke resource group atau subscription lain, tapi tidak ke region lain. Replikasi storage vault default adalah GRS (geo-redundant storage), dan hanya bisa diganti ke LRS (locally redundant storage) atau ZRS (zone-redundant storage) sebelum backup dikonfigurasi.

items.prompt: You have VMs (virtual machines) in East US and in West Europe, and you want to back them all up. What is the minimum number of Recovery Services vaults?
items.explanation: Vault harus satu region dengan VM (virtual machine) yang di-backup, jadi butuh satu vault di East US dan satu di West Europe.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: Vault rsv-eus is in East US, uses geo-redundant storage, and already stores backups of 20 VMs (virtual machines).

statements.text: You can move rsv-eus to another resource group.
You can move rsv-eus to West US.
You can change the storage replication of rsv-eus to locally redundant storage now.

items.explanation: Vault bisa pindah resource group atau subscription, tapi tidak pindah region. Replikasi storage hanya bisa diubah sebelum backup dikonfigurasi.

items.prompt: A VM (virtual machine) and the Recovery Services vault that backs it up can be in different subscriptions of the same tenant.
items.explanation: Benar. VM (virtual machine) dan vault boleh beda subscription dalam satu tenant, tapi harus di region yang sama.

items.title: Soft delete
items.body: Kalau data backup dihapus, misalnya lewat Stop backup dengan Delete Backup Data, datanya masuk status soft delete. Data itu disimpan 14 hari tambahan tanpa biaya, dan item bisa di-undelete lalu di-restore. Masa simpannya bisa diatur dari 14 sampai 180 hari. Vault tidak bisa dihapus selama masih ada item yang dilindungi, data backup, atau data dalam status soft delete.
keyPoints: Vault dengan data soft delete tidak bisa dihapus

items.prompt: Five days ago, an admin stopped backup of vm1 and deleted its backup data by mistake. Soft delete uses the default settings. What can you do?
options: Nothing, the backup data is gone
Undelete the backup item, then restore from it
Restore vm1 from the activity log
Wait 30 days for the data to return
items.explanation: Data yang dihapus masuk soft delete dan disimpan 14 hari. Lima hari masih di dalam masa itu, jadi item bisa di-undelete.

items.prompt: You stopped protection of every item in rsv-old and deleted the backup data. Deleting the vault now fails. What should you do?

scene.title: rsv-old > Delete
scene.message: Recovery Services vault cannot be deleted as there are backup items in soft deleted state in the vault.

options: Move the vault to another region first
Change the storage replication to locally redundant storage
Wait until the soft-deleted items are permanently deleted, then delete the vault
Delete the backup policies of the vault
items.explanation: Vault tidak bisa dihapus selama masih ada data dalam status soft delete. Setelah masa soft delete lewat, data dihapus permanen dan vault bisa dihapus.

items.title: Immutable vault
items.body: Immutable vault memblokir operasi yang bisa menghilangkan recovery point: menghapus data backup sebelum kedaluwarsa dan mengurangi retensi backup policy. Menambah retensi tetap boleh, begitu juga stop protection sambil menyimpan datanya. Immutability bisa dimatikan lagi, kecuali sudah dikunci (locked). Kunci ini melindungi backup walaupun penyerang, misalnya ransomware, mendapat akses admin.
keyPoints: Blokir hapus data dan kurangi retensi

items.prompt: Attackers with admin access might try to delete backups or shorten retention. Which vault setting blocks these operations and can be made irreversible?
items.explanation: Immutable vault memblokir penghapusan data dan pengurangan retensi. Kalau dikunci, pengaturannya tidak bisa dibatalkan.

items.prompt: Immutability is enabled on vault rsv1. Which two operations are still allowed? Choose two.
options: Stop protection and delete the backup data
Stop protection and retain the backup data
Increase the retention in a backup policy
Reduce the retention in a backup policy
items.explanation: Immutability hanya memblokir operasi yang bisa menghilangkan recovery point. Menambah retensi dan stop protection sambil menyimpan data tetap boleh.

items.title: Backup policy
items.body: Backup policy menentukan kapan backup berjalan dan berapa lama hasilnya disimpan. Policy default untuk VM (virtual machine) membuat backup sekali sehari, menyimpan backup harian 30 hari, dan menyimpan snapshot instant restore 2 hari. Di policy Standard buatan sendiri, jadwalnya harian atau mingguan, lalu retensi diatur untuk titik harian atau mingguan, ditambah titik bulanan dan tahunan kalau perlu. Satu policy melindungi paling banyak 100 VM.

items.prompt: You enable backup for vm1 with the default VM (virtual machine) backup policy. How long are the daily backups kept?
items.explanation: Policy default menyimpan backup harian 30 hari. Dua hari adalah retensi snapshot instant restore.

items.prompt: Create a policy that backs up every day, keeps each daily backup for 30 days, and also keeps the Sunday backup for 12 weeks.
items.blade: rsv-prod > Backup policies > Add > Azure Virtual Machine > Create policy
items.explanation: Jadwal harian dengan retensi harian 30 hari, ditambah titik mingguan hari Minggu yang disimpan 12 minggu. Titik bulanan tidak diminta.

items.prompt: One backup policy can protect up to 100 VMs (virtual machines).
items.explanation: Benar. Satu policy bisa melindungi paling banyak 100 VM (virtual machine), dan satu vault paling banyak 1.000 VM Azure.

items.title: Instant restore
items.body: Backup VM (virtual machine) berjalan dalam dua fase: snapshot disk, lalu transfer data ke vault. Begitu snapshot selesai, recovery point sudah bisa dipakai untuk restore tanpa menunggu transfer ke vault. Snapshot ini disimpan bersama disk selama 1 sampai 5 hari untuk Standard policy, dengan default 2 hari. Snapshot menambah biaya storage, jadi retensi panjang tetap disimpan di vault.

items.prompt: You must wait for the transfer to the vault to finish before you can restore from a new backup.
items.explanation: Salah. Recovery point sudah bisa dipakai begitu fase snapshot selesai.

items.prompt: With the Standard policy, how long can you keep the instant restore snapshots?
items.explanation: Standard policy menyimpan snapshot 1 sampai 5 hari, default 2. Rentang 1 sampai 30 hari milik Enhanced policy.

items.title: Enhanced policy
items.body: Enhanced policy bisa membuat backup beberapa kali sehari: setiap 4, 6, 8, 12, atau 24 jam. Policy ini mendukung Trusted Launch VM (virtual machine), Premium SSD (solid-state drive) v2, dan Ultra Disk; Standard policy tidak mendukung Premium SSD v2 dan Ultra Disk. Snapshot instant restore bisa disimpan 1 sampai 30 hari, dengan default 7. Setelah VM dilindungi Enhanced policy, VM itu tidak bisa dikembalikan ke Standard policy.
keyPoints: Wajib untuk Ultra Disk dan Premium SSD v2

items.prompt: vm-db must have a recovery point at least every 4 hours. What should you do?
options: Create a Standard policy with a weekly schedule
Increase the instant restore retention to 5 days
Protect it with an Enhanced policy that runs every 4 hours
items.explanation: Hanya Enhanced policy yang bisa backup beberapa kali sehari, paling sering setiap 4 jam.

items.prompt: After a VM (virtual machine) is protected with the Enhanced policy, you can move it back to the Standard policy.
items.explanation: Salah. VM (virtual machine) yang sudah memakai Enhanced policy tidak bisa dikembalikan ke Standard.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: vm-ultra has an Ultra Disk. You are planning its backup.

statements.text: The Standard policy can protect vm-ultra.
The Enhanced policy can protect vm-ultra.
The Enhanced policy can keep instant restore snapshots for 14 days.

items.explanation: Ultra Disk hanya didukung Enhanced policy, dan Enhanced policy menyimpan snapshot 1 sampai 30 hari.

items.prompt: Match each policy setting to what it controls.
pairs: When and how often backups run
How many days snapshots stay with the disks
How long recovery points stay in the vault
Whether the policy is Standard or Enhanced
items.explanation: Jadwal menentukan kapan backup berjalan, instant restore mengatur snapshot di samping disk, retention range mengatur recovery point di vault, dan subtype memilih Standard atau Enhanced.

items.title: Backup on-premises
items.body: Agen MARS (Microsoft Azure Recovery Services) dipasang di mesin Windows untuk mem-backup file, folder, dan system state langsung ke Recovery Services vault, sampai tiga kali sehari. Backup langsung mesin Linux dengan agen MARS tidak didukung. Untuk data aplikasi, misalnya database, pakai MABS (Microsoft Azure Backup Server) atau DPM (Data Protection Manager). Keduanya menyimpan backup di storage lokal dulu, lalu meneruskannya ke vault.
keyPoints: MARS: file, folder, system state Windows

items.prompt: The folders of an on-premises Windows file server must be backed up to Azure three times a day. There is no backup server. What should you install on the file server?
options: The MARS (Microsoft Azure Recovery Services) agent
The backup extension for Azure VMs (virtual machines)
items.explanation: Agen MARS (Microsoft Azure Recovery Services) mem-backup file dan folder mesin Windows langsung ke vault, sampai tiga kali sehari.

items.prompt: The MARS (Microsoft Azure Recovery Services) agent can back up an on-premises Linux server directly to Azure.
items.explanation: Salah. Backup langsung mesin Linux dengan agen MARS (Microsoft Azure Recovery Services) tidak didukung.

items.title: Mengaktifkan backup VM
items.body: Saat backup VM (virtual machine) diaktifkan, pilih vault dan policy, lalu pilih VM; hanya VM di region yang sama dengan vault yang muncul. Azure Backup lalu memasang backup extension di VM. Backup pertama berjalan sesuai jadwal, atau langsung dengan Backup Now, yang menanyakan sampai kapan recovery point itu disimpan. VM yang mati tetap di-backup, tapi recovery point-nya crash-consistent.
keyPoints: Hanya VM satu region dengan vault
Backup Now: backup di luar jadwal

items.prompt: You configure backup in vault rsv-weu in West Europe. vm-eus in East US does not appear in the list of VMs (virtual machines). Why?
options: Only VMs in the same region as the vault can be selected
vm-eus has no public IP (Internet Protocol) address
items.explanation: Hanya VM (virtual machine) di region yang sama dengan vault yang bisa dipilih. VM yang mati tetap bisa di-backup.

items.prompt: Azure Backup cannot back up a VM (virtual machine) that is turned off.
items.explanation: Salah. VM (virtual machine) yang mati tetap di-backup, dengan recovery point crash-consistent.

items.prompt: You enabled backup for vm1 today. You need a recovery point before a risky update in one hour. What should you do?
options: Wait for the next scheduled backup
items.explanation: Backup Now menjalankan backup on-demand di luar jadwal.

items.title: Pilihan restore VM
items.body: Create a new VM (virtual machine) membuat VM (virtual machine) baru dari recovery point, di region yang sama dengan VM sumber. Restore disk memulihkan disk saja dan memberi template untuk membuat VM dengan pengaturan sendiri; disk itu juga bisa dipasang ke VM lain. Replace existing mengganti disk VM yang masih ada, setelah Azure Backup mengambil snapshot VM itu. Kalau VM sudah dihapus, Replace existing tidak bisa dipakai.
keyPoints: Create a new VM: VM baru, region sama
Replace existing: VM harus masih ada

items.prompt: Match each restore option to what it does.
pairs: Builds a new VM from the recovery point
Restores the disks and gives a template to build a VM
Swaps the disks of a VM that still exists
items.explanation: Create a new VM (virtual machine) membuat VM (virtual machine) baru, Restore disk memberi disk dan template, dan Replace existing mengganti disk VM yang masih ada.

items.prompt: An update corrupted the disks of vm-app, but the VM (virtual machine) still exists. You want to keep vm-app and put back the disks from yesterday. Which restore option should you use?
items.explanation: Replace existing mengganti disk VM (virtual machine) yang masih ada dengan disk dari recovery point.

items.prompt: You can use Replace existing after the original VM (virtual machine) has been deleted.
items.explanation: Salah. Replace existing butuh VM (virtual machine) yang masih ada. Kalau VM sudah dihapus, pakai Create a new VM atau Restore disk.

items.title: Cross Region Restore
items.body: Dengan GRS (geo-redundant storage), data vault disalin ke paired region. Cross Region Restore memakai salinan itu untuk memulihkan VM (virtual machine) di paired region kapan saja, misalnya untuk drill audit, tanpa menunggu Azure menyatakan bencana. Fitur ini hanya ada di Recovery Services vault dengan GRS. Pilihan restore-nya Create a VM dan Restore disk; Replace existing tidak didukung.
keyPoints: Restore ke paired region kapan saja

items.prompt: The primary region has an outage. You want to restore vm1 in the paired region now, without waiting for Microsoft to declare a disaster. What must already be in place?
options: A Recovery Services vault with geo-redundant storage and Cross Region Restore enabled
A vault with locally redundant storage
A Backup vault with zone-redundant storage
items.explanation: Cross Region Restore hanya ada di Recovery Services vault dengan GRS (geo-redundant storage).

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: Vault rsv1 uses locally redundant storage and already protects 20 VMs (virtual machines).

statements.text: You can enable Cross Region Restore on rsv1 now.
A restore to the paired region needs a vault with geo-redundant storage.
Cross Region Restore can replace the disks of an existing VM.

items.explanation: Cross Region Restore butuh GRS (geo-redundant storage), dan replikasi rsv1 tidak bisa diubah lagi karena backup sudah ada. Replace existing tidak didukung di Cross Region Restore.

items.title: Memulihkan file dari backup VM
items.body: Untuk memulihkan beberapa file tanpa me-restore seluruh VM (virtual machine), buka VM > Backup > File Recovery. Pilih recovery point, unduh script (executable untuk Windows, Python untuk Linux), lalu jalankan dengan password yang diberikan. Volume dari recovery point di-mount sebagai drive, file disalin, lalu pilih Unmount disks. Script berlaku 12 jam, dan File Recovery tidak mendukung VM terenkripsi.
keyPoints: Satu file: File Recovery, bukan restore VM

items.prompt: A user deleted one folder on vm-files. The rest of the VM (virtual machine) is fine. How do you get the folder back with the least effort?
options: Restore the whole VM with Create a new VM
Fail over the VM with Site Recovery
Use File Recovery to mount the recovery point and copy the folder
items.explanation: File Recovery me-mount volume recovery point sebagai drive, jadi folder bisa disalin tanpa me-restore VM (virtual machine).

items.prompt: The File Recovery script stays valid for 12 hours.
items.explanation: Benar. Script berlaku 12 jam. Pilih Unmount disks untuk mencabut aksesnya lebih cepat.

items.prompt: Recover a file from a VM (virtual machine) backup. Put the steps in order.
items: Select a recovery point in File Recovery
Download the script and copy its password
Run the script to mount the recovery volumes
items.explanation: Pilih recovery point, unduh script, jalankan untuk me-mount volume, salin file, lalu Unmount disks.

items.title: Backup Azure Files
items.body: Azure Files di-backup lewat Recovery Services vault dengan dua tier. Snapshot tier memakai snapshot file share yang tersimpan di storage account yang sama, jadi file tertentu bisa di-restore dengan cepat. Vaulted tier menyalin data ke vault, sehingga backup tetap ada walaupun storage account-nya hilang. Replikasi storage vault hanya berlaku untuk vaulted backup.
keyPoints: Snapshot: di storage account yang sama

items.prompt: Backups of the file share share1 must survive even if its storage account is deleted. Which Azure Files backup tier should you use?
items.explanation: Snapshot tersimpan di storage account yang sama dengan file share. Vaulted menyalin data ke vault, jadi tetap aman kalau storage account hilang.

items.title: Azure Site Recovery
items.body: Azure Site Recovery mereplikasi VM (virtual machine) Azure secara terus-menerus ke region lain. Saat replikasi diaktifkan, Mobility service extension dipasang di VM, dan perubahan disk ditulis dulu ke cache storage account di region sumber sebelum dikirim ke region target. VM butuh koneksi keluar, bukan masuk. Vault untuk Site Recovery dibuat di region mana pun kecuali region sumber, kebalikan dari backup yang vault-nya harus satu region dengan VM.
keyPoints: Cache storage account di region sumber

items.prompt: VMs (virtual machines) in Southeast Asia must be replicated to East Asia with Site Recovery. Where can you create the Recovery Services vault?
options: Only in the region of the VMs
Nowhere; Site Recovery uses a Backup vault
items.explanation: Vault Site Recovery boleh di region mana pun kecuali region sumber (Southeast Asia). Region target seperti East Asia bisa dipakai.

items.prompt: Site Recovery needs inbound connectivity to the replicated VMs (virtual machines).
items.explanation: Salah. VM (virtual machine) butuh koneksi keluar; Site Recovery tidak pernah butuh koneksi masuk.

items.prompt: During replication, where are the disk writes of a VM (virtual machine) sent first?
options: A cache storage account in the source region
A storage account in the target region
items.explanation: Perubahan disk ditulis dulu ke cache storage account di region sumber, lalu dikirim ke region target.

items.title: Recovery point replikasi
items.body: Site Recovery membuat recovery point crash-consistent setiap 5 menit, dan interval ini tidak bisa diubah. Recovery point app-consistent juga menangkap data yang masih di memori aplikasi, tapi hanya dibuat kalau frekuensinya diatur di replication policy. Secara default, fitur itu mati dan recovery point disimpan satu hari. Retensi yang lebih panjang menambah biaya storage.

items.prompt: How often does Site Recovery create crash-consistent recovery points for Azure VMs (virtual machines)?
items.explanation: Recovery point crash-consistent dibuat setiap 5 menit, dan interval ini tidak bisa diubah.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: You enable replication for vm1 with the default replication policy.

statements.text: A crash-consistent recovery point is created every 5 minutes.
App-consistent recovery points are created every hour.
Recovery points are kept for one day.

items.explanation: Default replication policy: crash-consistent tiap 5 menit, app-consistent mati, dan retensi satu hari.

items.title: Test failover
items.body: Test failover membuat VM (virtual machine) di region target dari recovery point tanpa mengganggu produksi. Pilih VNet (virtual network) non-produksi supaya alamat IP (Internet Protocol) tidak bentrok, lalu jalankan Cleanup test failover untuk menghapus VM uji. Pilihan recovery point: Latest processed untuk RTO (recovery time objective) rendah, Latest untuk RPO (recovery point objective) terendah, Latest app-consistent, atau Custom.
keyPoints: Latest: RPO terendah; Latest processed: RTO rendah

items.prompt: Every quarter you must prove that failover to the secondary region works, without any impact on production. What should you run?
options: A test failover into a non-production virtual network
items.explanation: Test failover membuat VM (virtual machine) uji di region target tanpa mengganggu produksi, lalu dibersihkan dengan Cleanup test failover.

items.prompt: During a failover you want the lowest possible data loss, even if the failover takes longer. Which recovery point should you choose?
items.explanation: Latest memproses semua data yang sudah terkirim dulu, jadi RPO (recovery point objective) terendah. Latest processed lebih cepat dan memberi RTO (recovery time objective) rendah, tapi datanya sedikit lebih lama.

items.title: Failover, commit, dan re-protect
items.body: Saat region primer bermasalah, Failover membuat VM (virtual machine) di region target dari recovery point pilihan. Kalau hasilnya sudah benar, Commit menyelesaikan failover dan menghapus recovery point lain, jadi recovery point tidak bisa diganti lagi. Re-protect lalu membuat VM di region target mereplikasi balik ke region primer. Setelah region primer pulih, failback adalah failover lagi ke arah primer.
keyPoints: Commit: recovery point tidak bisa diganti

items.prompt: After you commit a failover, you can still change the recovery point.
items.explanation: Salah. Commit menghapus recovery point lain, jadi recovery point tidak bisa diganti lagi.

items.prompt: vm1 has failed over to West US 2 and the failover is committed. What makes vm1 replicate back to the original region?
items.explanation: Re-protect membuat VM (virtual machine) di region target mereplikasi balik ke region primer.

items.prompt: Put the Site Recovery steps in order, from the first drill to failback.
items: Run a test failover and clean it up
Fail over to the target region
Fail back to the primary region
items.explanation: Drill dengan test failover, failover, commit, re-protect agar VM (virtual machine) mereplikasi balik, lalu failback.

items.title: Recovery plan
items.body: Recovery plan mengelompokkan VM (virtual machine) supaya di-failover bersama dengan urutan start tertentu. Contoh aplikasi tiga tier: database dulu, lalu middleware, lalu web. Satu plan bisa berisi sampai 100 instance, ditambah skrip atau langkah manual, dan bisa diuji dengan test failover. Recovery point Custom hanya tersedia saat failover satu VM tanpa recovery plan.

items.prompt: After failover, the database VM (virtual machine) must start before the web VMs. What should you configure?
options: A recovery plan with groups in that order
items.explanation: Recovery plan mengatur VM (virtual machine) yang di-failover bersama dan urutan start-nya.

items.title: Memantau job backup
items.body: Setiap backup dan restore tercatat sebagai job. Di Recovery Services vault, buka Backup Jobs lalu filter status Failed untuk melihat job yang gagal. Untuk melihat job dari banyak vault, subscription, dan region dalam satu tampilan, pakai Resiliency, penerus Backup center dan Azure Business Continuity Center. Activity log vault mencatat operasi pengguna, misalnya mengubah backup policy atau memulai restore.

items.prompt: You must see every failed backup job from this week across 12 vaults in 3 subscriptions, in one view. What should you use?
options: The jobs view in Resiliency, filtered to Failed
The Backup Jobs page of one vault
items.explanation: Resiliency, penerus Backup center, menampilkan job dari banyak vault, subscription, dan region sekaligus. Backup Jobs di vault hanya melihat satu vault.

items.prompt: The activity log of a vault shows who changed a backup policy.
items.explanation: Benar. Activity log mencatat operasi pengguna seperti mengubah backup policy atau memulai restore.

items.title: Alert bawaan backup
items.body: Azure Backup memakai alert Azure Monitor. Security alert, misalnya saat data backup dihapus atau soft delete dimatikan, selalu dibuat dan tidak bisa dimatikan. Alert kegagalan job backup atau restore aktif secara default, tapi bisa dimatikan. Untuk mengirim email, buat alert processing rule yang menambahkan action group. Classic alerts Azure Backup dihentikan pada 31 Maret 2026.
keyPoints: Email: alert processing rule dan action group

items.prompt: You want an email whenever any backup job fails. The built-in alerts are on. What should you add?
options: An alert processing rule that adds an action group with an email action
items.explanation: Alert bawaan sudah dibuat, tapi notifikasinya dikirim lewat alert processing rule yang menambahkan action group.

items.prompt: You can turn off the built-in security alert that fires when backup data is deleted.
items.explanation: Salah. Security alert selalu dibuat dan tidak bisa dimatikan. Yang bisa diatur hanya notifikasinya.

items.prompt: Which two events fire built-in security alerts in Azure Backup? Choose two.
options: Soft delete is disabled for a vault
items.explanation: Penghapusan data backup dan mematikan soft delete adalah security alert. Kegagalan job backup dan restore termasuk alert job failure.

items.title: Backup Reports
items.body: Backup Reports menampilkan tren jangka panjang: job yang berhasil dan gagal, pemakaian storage, dan kepatuhan policy. Datanya dikirim vault lewat diagnostic setting ke Log Analytics workspace, lalu ditampilkan dengan Azure workbooks. Workspace boleh di region dan subscription berbeda dari vault. Data pertama bisa butuh sampai 24 jam, dan retensi workspace default 30 hari, jadi perpanjang retensinya untuk laporan tahunan.
keyPoints: Tren jangka panjang, bukan real time

items.prompt: Management wants a report of backup storage usage and job success for the past 12 months. What must you configure first?
options: Diagnostic settings on the vaults that send data to a Log Analytics workspace with long enough retention
A metric alert on each vault
items.explanation: Backup Reports membaca data dari Log Analytics workspace yang diisi lewat diagnostic setting vault. Retensi workspace harus cukup panjang untuk 12 bulan.

items.prompt: You created diagnostic settings for all vaults one hour ago, but Backup Reports still shows no data. What should you do?

scene.title: Backup Reports > Summary
scene.message: No data to display for the selected workspace and time range.

options: Change the vaults to geo-redundant storage
Wait, because the first data can take up to 24 hours to arrive
items.explanation: Setelah diagnostic setting dibuat, data pertama bisa butuh sampai 24 jam untuk masuk ke workspace.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: Vault rsv1 is in East US. Workspace law-bkp is in West Europe, in another subscription.

statements.text: rsv1 can send its data to law-bkp for Backup Reports.
law-bkp keeps the data for 30 days unless you change its retention.
Backup Reports work without any diagnostic setting.

items.explanation: Workspace boleh beda region dan subscription dari vault, retensinya default 30 hari, dan data hanya masuk lewat diagnostic setting.

items.title: Role Azure Backup
items.body: Azure Backup punya tiga role bawaan. Backup Contributor bisa melakukan semua operasi backup, kecuali menghapus vault dan memberi akses ke orang lain. Backup Operator sama seperti Contributor, tapi tidak bisa menghapus backup atau mengelola backup policy. Backup Reader hanya bisa melihat, cocok untuk tim pemantauan.
keyPoints: Contributor: kelola semua kecuali hapus vault
Operator: tanpa hapus backup dan policy

items.prompt: An operator must enable backups and run restores, but must never delete backup data or change backup policies. Which role should you assign?
items.explanation: Backup Operator bisa semua yang dilakukan Contributor, kecuali menghapus backup dan mengelola backup policy.

items.prompt: Match each role to what it allows.
pairs: Manage backups and policies, but not delete the vault
Run backups and restores, but not delete backups or manage policies
items.explanation: Contributor mengelola semua kecuali menghapus vault dan memberi akses, Operator tanpa menghapus backup dan mengelola policy, dan Reader hanya melihat.

items.title: Membuat dan menghapus Backup vault
items.body: Backup vault dipakai untuk Azure Disks, Azure Blobs, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, dan Kubernetes. Saat membuatnya, pilih subscription, resource group, nama, region, dan storage redundancy, misalnya geo-redundant (default) atau locally redundant yang lebih murah. Storage redundancy tidak bisa diubah setelah ada item yang dilindungi. Vault memakai managed identity untuk mengakses resource yang di-backup. Vault baru bisa dihapus setelah semua backup instance dan backup policy di dalamnya dihapus.
keyPoints: Hapus instance dan policy sebelum vault

items.prompt: A company creates a Backup vault for blob backups. Azure is not its primary backup storage, and the company wants the lowest storage cost. Which storage redundancy should the company choose?
options: Any option, because it can be changed after the first backup
items.explanation: Locally redundant lebih murah dan cocok kalau Azure bukan penyimpanan backup utama. Storage redundancy tidak bisa diubah setelah ada item yang dilindungi, jadi pilih dengan benar sejak awal.

items.prompt: You can change the storage redundancy of a Backup vault after items are protected in it.
items.explanation: Storage redundancy Backup vault tidak bisa diubah setelah ada item yang dilindungi di vault.

items.prompt: Deleting the Backup vault bv-old fails with an error about existing backup instances or backup policies. What should you do?
options: Change the storage redundancy of bv-old to locally redundant, and then try again
Delete every backup instance and backup policy in bv-old first
Move bv-old to another resource group, and then delete it
Turn off the managed identity of bv-old
items.explanation: Backup vault tidak bisa dihapus selama masih berisi backup instance atau backup policy. Hapus semuanya dulu, lalu hapus vault.

items.title: Backup managed disk
items.body: Azure Disk Backup membuat incremental snapshot tanpa agen, setiap 1 sampai 12 jam atau harian. Snapshot disimpan di resource group snapshot di subscription kamu (operational tier), bukan di storage vault, jadi redundancy vault tidak berlaku. Vault dan disk harus satu region, tapi boleh beda subscription; resource group snapshot harus satu subscription dengan disk. Managed identity vault butuh Disk Backup Reader di disk dan Disk Snapshot Contributor di resource group snapshot.
keyPoints: Disk Backup Reader dan Disk Snapshot Contributor
items.trap: Untuk backup app-consistent seluruh VM (virtual machine), restore file, atau restore ke region lain, pakai Azure VM backup di Recovery Services vault, bukan Disk Backup.

items.prompt: Only the data disk of vm-db must be backed up every 4 hours, without installing any agent and without touching the rest of the VM (virtual machine). What should the company use?
options: Azure Disk Backup in a Backup vault
Azure VM backup with the Standard policy
The MARS (Microsoft Azure Recovery Services) agent on vm-db
Azure Site Recovery replication of vm-db
items.explanation: Azure Disk Backup membuat incremental snapshot per disk tanpa agen, dan bisa dijadwalkan setiap 4 jam. Standard policy VM (virtual machine) backup hanya harian atau mingguan dan mem-backup seluruh VM.

items.prompt: A company's Backup vault bv1 is in West Europe, in the subscription Sub-A. Based on the table, which disks can bv1 back up with Azure Disk Backup?
items.explanation: Vault dan disk harus di region yang sama, tapi boleh di subscription berbeda, jadi disk1 dan disk2 bisa. disk3 ada di region lain. Di portal hanya disk di subscription yang sama yang bisa dipilih; disk di subscription lain diatur lewat PowerShell atau CLI (command-line interface).

items.prompt: Configuring Azure Disk Backup for disk1 fails because of missing permissions. Which roles should the managed identity of the Backup vault have?
options: Disk Backup Reader on disk1, and Disk Snapshot Contributor on the snapshot resource group
Disk Snapshot Contributor on disk1, and Disk Backup Reader on the snapshot resource group
Backup Contributor on the Backup vault only, which covers every disk
Owner on the subscription, because no narrower role exists
items.explanation: Managed identity vault butuh Disk Backup Reader di disk sumber dan Disk Snapshot Contributor di resource group snapshot.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: Contoso plans to protect disk1 with Azure Disk Backup in bv1, which uses geo-redundant storage.

statements.text: The backups are incremental snapshots in a resource group in Contoso's subscription.
The geo-redundant setting of bv1 copies the snapshots to the paired region.
The snapshot resource group can be in a different subscription from disk1.

items.explanation: Disk Backup menyimpan incremental snapshot di resource group snapshot di subscription kamu, bukan di storage vault, jadi redundancy vault tidak berlaku. Resource group snapshot harus satu subscription dengan disk.

items.title: Backup blob
items.body: Backup blob punya dua tier. Operational backup bersifat kontinu: datanya tetap di storage account sumber dan dipulihkan dengan point-in-time restore. Vaulted backup terjadwal dan menyalin data ke Backup vault, jadi data tetap ada meskipun storage account-nya terhapus; policy baru selalu menyertakan vaulted backup. Keduanya hanya untuk block blob di storage account standard general-purpose v2, dan managed identity vault butuh role Storage Account Backup Contributor di storage account itu.
keyPoints: Operational: kontinu, di storage account sumber

items.prompt: A company must be able to recover its blobs even if someone deletes the whole storage account. Which blob backup tier protects against this?
options: Operational backup, which keeps the data in the storage account
Blob soft delete in the storage account
Blob snapshots in the same container
items.explanation: Operational backup menyimpan data di storage account sumber. Vaulted backup menyalin data ke Backup vault, jadi tetap ada meskipun storage account-nya terhapus.

items.prompt: A company plans to protect several storage accounts with Azure Blob backup. Which account can it protect?
options: A standard general-purpose v2 account that holds block blobs
A standard account that holds only page blobs
Any storage account that has a lifecycle management policy configured
items.explanation: Backup blob, operational maupun vaulted, hanya untuk block blob di storage account standard general-purpose v2.

items.prompt: Configuring blob backup for the storage account stdata fails with a permission error. What should you assign to the managed identity of the Backup vault?
options: Storage Blob Data Reader on stdata
Storage Account Backup Contributor on stdata
Backup Contributor on the Backup vault and on its resource group
items.explanation: Managed identity vault butuh role Storage Account Backup Contributor di storage account yang dilindungi. Backup Contributor mengatur siapa yang boleh mengelola backup, bukan izin vault ke storage account.

items.prompt: A company compares the ways that Azure Backup protects data. Match each solution with how it works.
pairs: Continuous, kept in the source storage account
Scheduled, copied to the Backup vault
Incremental snapshots in a snapshot resource group
App-consistent backup of a whole VM (virtual machine) in a Recovery Services vault
items.explanation: Operational blob backup tetap di storage account sumber, vaulted backup disalin ke Backup vault, Disk Backup memakai snapshot di resource group snapshot, dan VM (virtual machine) backup melindungi seluruh VM di Recovery Services vault.

items.prompt: A company must back up Azure virtual machines, Azure file shares, Azure managed disks with Azure Disk Backup, and Azure Blobs. Which two workloads need a Backup vault? Choose two.
options: Azure managed disks with Azure Disk Backup
items.explanation: Backup vault melindungi Azure Disks, Azure Blobs, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, dan Kubernetes. VM (virtual machine) dan Azure Files di-backup ke Recovery Services vault.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: Contoso plans to create rsv-prod in West Europe to back up virtual machines in West Europe that are in two subscriptions of the same tenant.

statements.text: rsv-prod can back up the virtual machines in both subscriptions.
rsv-prod can also back up virtual machines in North Europe.
Contoso can change rsv-prod from GRS (geo-redundant storage) to LRS (locally redundant storage) before it configures any backup.

items.explanation: VM (virtual machine) dan vault harus satu region, tapi boleh beda subscription dalam tenant yang sama. Replikasi storage vault hanya bisa diubah sebelum backup dikonfigurasi.

items.prompt: An administrator at a company deleted the backup data of vm-hr 20 days ago. The vault uses soft delete with the default 14-day retention. What is true?
options: The data can still be undeleted, because soft delete keeps deleted data for 30 days
The data can be restored from the activity log of the vault
The data can no longer be undeleted, because the soft delete period has ended
The data can be undeleted at any time, because soft delete never expires
items.explanation: Data yang dihapus disimpan 14 hari tambahan dalam status soft delete. Setelah 20 hari, masa itu sudah lewat. Masa simpan bisa diatur 14 sampai 180 hari sebelumnya.

items.prompt: A company needs a vault for the backups of Azure Database for PostgreSQL and Azure Blobs. What should the company create?
options: A key vault with soft delete
items.explanation: Backup vault melindungi Azure Database for PostgreSQL dan Azure Blobs. Recovery Services vault untuk VM (virtual machine), Azure Files, on-premises, dan Site Recovery.

items.prompt: You need to protect disk-app, in East US, with Azure Disk Backup. Based on the table, which vault should you use?
items.explanation: Azure Disk Backup memakai Backup vault, dan vault harus di region yang sama dengan disk. rsv-eus adalah Recovery Services vault, dan bv-weu ada di region lain.

items.prompt: vm-app was deleted by mistake. A company wants it back from yesterday's recovery point in the vault. Which restore option should the company use?
options: Backup Now on vm-app, and then restore
File Recovery, run once for each of its disks
items.explanation: Replace existing hanya untuk VM (virtual machine) yang masih ada. Create a new VM membuat VM baru dari recovery point.

items.prompt: After a regional outage, a company must fail over vm-web to the secondary region as fast as possible. A few minutes of data loss is acceptable. Which recovery point should the company choose?
options: Custom, for every virtual machine in a recovery plan
items.explanation: Latest processed memberi RTO (recovery time objective) terendah karena recovery point-nya sudah diproses. Latest memberi RPO (recovery point objective) terendah tapi butuh waktu lebih lama.

items.prompt: A company failed over vm1 to West US 2, and the app works. The company now wants vm1 to replicate back to the primary region. What should the company do?
options: Run a test failover, and then clean it up
Fail back to the primary region right away
Commit the failover, and then re-protect vm1
Turn off replication, and then create a recovery plan
items.explanation: Commit menyelesaikan failover. Setelah itu, Re-protect membuat VM (virtual machine) di region target mereplikasi balik ke region primer, dan baru setelahnya failback.

items.prompt: After a failover of vm1, a company finds that the chosen recovery point holds corrupted data. The failover is not committed yet. What should the company do?
options: Commit the failover first, and then change the recovery point to an earlier one
Change the recovery point to an earlier one, and then commit
Re-protect vm1, and then fail over again
Run Cleanup test failover on vm1
items.explanation: Sebelum commit, recovery point masih bisa diganti. Commit menghapus recovery point lain, jadi setelah commit recovery point tidak bisa diganti lagi.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: Contoso plans a test failover of vm1 to the secondary region.

statements.text: The test failover stops replication of vm1 to the secondary region.
Contoso should connect the test VM (virtual machine) to the production virtual network.
After the test, Contoso should run Cleanup test failover to delete the test VM.

items.explanation: Test failover tidak mengganggu produksi maupun replikasi. Pilih VNet (virtual network) non-produksi, lalu jalankan Cleanup test failover untuk menghapus VM (virtual machine) uji.

facts.statement: Recovery Services vault melindungi VM (virtual machine) Azure, SQL (Structured Query Language) Server di VM Azure, SAP HANA di VM Azure, Azure Files, dan workload on-premises lewat agen MARS (Microsoft Azure Recovery Services), MABS (Microsoft Azure Backup Server), dan DPM (Data Protection Manager). Vault ini juga dipakai Azure Site Recovery.
Backup vault melindungi Azure Disks, Azure Blobs, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, dan Kubernetes. Pilih jenis vault menurut jenis resource yang dilindungi.

Backup berlaku dalam satu region: vault harus di region yang sama dengan VM (virtual machine) yang di-backup, jadi setiap region yang punya VM butuh vault sendiri. VM dan vault boleh berada di subscription berbeda dalam tenant yang sama.
Vault bisa dipindah ke resource group atau subscription lain, tapi tidak ke region lain. Data backup juga tidak bisa dipindah antar vault.

Replikasi storage Recovery Services vault default adalah GRS (geo-redundant storage); pilihan lainnya LRS (locally redundant storage) dan ZRS (zone-redundant storage). Replikasinya hanya bisa diubah sebelum backup dikonfigurasi di vault.
Data backup yang dihapus masuk status soft delete dan disimpan 14 hari tambahan tanpa biaya, jadi item itu masih bisa di-undelete. Masa simpan soft delete bisa diatur dari 14 sampai 180 hari.
Recovery Services vault tidak bisa dihapus selama masih berisi item yang dilindungi, data backup, atau data backup dalam status soft delete.

Immutable vault memblokir operasi yang bisa menghilangkan recovery point, seperti menghapus data backup sebelum kedaluwarsa atau mengurangi retensi policy. Menambah retensi dan stop protection sambil menyimpan data tetap boleh. Kalau immutability dikunci (locked), pengaturannya tidak bisa dibatalkan.
Policy default untuk backup VM (virtual machine) membuat backup sekali sehari, menyimpan backup harian 30 hari, dan menyimpan snapshot instant restore 2 hari.
Di policy VM (virtual machine) Standard, jadwal backup harian atau mingguan. Retensi diatur untuk titik backup harian atau mingguan, dan bisa ditambah retensi titik bulanan dan tahunan.
Satu backup policy bisa melindungi paling banyak 100 VM (virtual machine), dan satu vault paling banyak 1.000 VM Azure.

Backup VM (virtual machine) punya dua fase: snapshot, lalu transfer data ke vault. Recovery point sudah bisa dipakai untuk restore begitu snapshot selesai. Snapshot disimpan 1 sampai 5 hari untuk Standard policy (default 2) dan 1 sampai 30 hari untuk Enhanced policy (default 7).

Enhanced policy bisa membuat backup setiap 4, 6, 8, 12, atau 24 jam, dan mendukung Trusted Launch VM (virtual machine), Premium SSD (solid-state drive) v2, dan Ultra Disk. Standard policy tidak mendukung Premium SSD v2 dan Ultra Disk. Setelah VM memakai Enhanced policy, VM itu tidak bisa dikembalikan ke Standard policy.

Agen MARS (Microsoft Azure Recovery Services) mem-backup file, folder, dan system state mesin Windows langsung ke Recovery Services vault, sampai tiga kali sehari. Backup langsung mesin Linux dengan agen MARS tidak didukung.

MABS (Microsoft Azure Backup Server) dan DPM (Data Protection Manager) mem-backup file, volume, system state, dan data aplikasi dengan snapshot yang sadar aplikasi ke storage lokal, lalu meneruskannya ke vault.

Saat backup VM (virtual machine) diaktifkan, hanya VM di region yang sama dengan vault yang bisa dipilih, dan Azure Backup memasang backup extension di VM. VM yang mati tetap di-backup, tapi recovery point-nya crash-consistent.
Backup Now menjalankan backup on-demand di luar jadwal, dan retensinya ditentukan saat itu dengan memilih hari terakhir recovery point disimpan.
Opsi Create a new VM membuat VM (virtual machine) baru dari recovery point, di region yang sama dengan VM sumber.
Opsi Restore disk memulihkan disk VM (virtual machine) dan menyediakan template untuk membuat VM dengan pengaturan kustom. Disk itu juga bisa dipasang ke VM yang sudah ada.

Opsi Replace existing mengganti disk VM (virtual machine) yang masih ada dengan disk dari recovery point, setelah Azure Backup mengambil snapshot VM itu. Opsi ini tidak bisa dipakai kalau VM sudah dihapus.

Cross Region Restore memulihkan VM (virtual machine) di paired region kapan saja, tanpa menunggu Azure menyatakan bencana. Fitur ini hanya untuk Recovery Services vault dengan GRS (geo-redundant storage), dan mendukung Create a VM dan Restore disk, tapi tidak Replace existing.

File Recovery memulihkan file atau folder tanpa me-restore seluruh VM (virtual machine): pilih recovery point, unduh script, jalankan untuk me-mount volume recovery point, salin file, lalu Unmount disks. Script berlaku 12 jam, dan VM terenkripsi tidak didukung.

Azure Files di-backup lewat Recovery Services vault dengan dua tier: snapshot, yang disimpan di storage account yang sama dengan file share, dan vaulted, yang menyalin data ke vault. Replikasi storage vault hanya berlaku untuk vaulted backup.

Azure Site Recovery mereplikasi VM (virtual machine) Azure secara terus-menerus ke region lain. Mobility service extension dipasang di VM, dan perubahan disk ditulis dulu ke cache storage account di region sumber sebelum dikirim ke region target.
Recovery Services vault untuk Site Recovery dibuat di region mana pun kecuali region sumber VM (virtual machine) yang direplikasi.
VM (virtual machine) yang direplikasi Site Recovery butuh koneksi keluar. Site Recovery tidak pernah butuh koneksi masuk ke VM.

Site Recovery membuat recovery point crash-consistent setiap 5 menit, dan interval ini tidak bisa diubah. Recovery point app-consistent hanya dibuat kalau frekuensinya diatur, dan retensi recovery point default adalah satu hari.

Test failover membuat VM (virtual machine) di region target dari recovery point tanpa mengganggu produksi. Pilih VNet (virtual network) non-produksi, lalu jalankan Cleanup test failover untuk menghapus VM uji.

Pilihan recovery point saat failover: Latest processed memberi RTO (recovery time objective) rendah, Latest memberi RPO (recovery point objective) terendah, Latest app-consistent memakai titik app-consistent terakhir, dan Custom memilih titik tertentu untuk satu VM (virtual machine) tanpa recovery plan.
Setelah failover, Commit menyelesaikannya dan menghapus recovery point lain, sehingga recovery point tidak bisa diganti lagi.
Re-protect membuat VM (virtual machine) di region target mereplikasi balik ke region primer. Failback adalah failover lagi dari region target ke region primer.

Recovery plan mengelompokkan VM (virtual machine) supaya di-failover bersama dengan urutan start tertentu, misalnya database, lalu middleware, lalu web. Satu plan bisa berisi sampai 100 instance dan bisa diuji dengan test failover.

Setiap backup dan restore tercatat sebagai job. Di vault, menu Backup Jobs bisa difilter menurut status, misalnya Failed. Activity log vault mencatat operasi pengguna, seperti mengubah backup policy atau memulai restore.
Resiliency, penerus Backup center dan Azure Business Continuity Center, menampilkan job, item, dan alert backup dari banyak vault, subscription, dan region dalam satu tampilan.

Azure Backup punya alert bawaan di Azure Monitor. Security alert, misalnya saat data backup dihapus atau soft delete dimatikan, selalu dibuat dan tidak bisa dimatikan. Alert kegagalan job backup dan restore aktif secara default dan bisa dimatikan.
Untuk mengirim notifikasi seperti email dari alert backup, pakai alert processing rule dan action group Azure Monitor. Classic alerts Azure Backup dihentikan pada 31 Maret 2026.

Backup Reports memakai Log Analytics workspace dan Azure workbooks untuk tren jangka panjang: job, pemakaian storage, dan kepatuhan policy. Vault mengirim datanya lewat diagnostic setting, dan data pertama bisa butuh sampai 24 jam.

Log Analytics workspace untuk Backup Reports boleh berada di region dan subscription berbeda dari vault. Datanya disimpan 30 hari secara default, jadi perpanjang retensinya untuk laporan jangka panjang.

Role bawaan Azure Backup: Backup Contributor bisa semua operasi backup kecuali menghapus vault dan memberi akses; Backup Operator sama tapi tidak bisa menghapus backup atau mengelola backup policy; Backup Reader hanya melihat.

Backup vault dibuat dengan memilih subscription, resource group, nama, region, dan storage redundancy. Geo-redundant (default) disarankan kalau Azure adalah penyimpanan backup utama; locally redundant lebih murah. Storage redundancy tidak bisa diubah setelah ada item yang dilindungi di vault.
Backup vault tidak bisa dihapus selama masih berisi backup instance atau backup policy. Hapus dulu semua backup instance dan backup policy, lalu hapus vault-nya.

Backup vault memakai managed identity, system-assigned yang dibuat otomatis atau user-assigned, untuk mengakses resource yang di-backup. Identity itu diberi role Azure RBAC (role-based access control) yang dibutuhkan setiap workload.

Azure Disk Backup tanpa agen dan crash-consistent: Azure Backup membuat incremental snapshot di resource group snapshot di subscription kamu (operational tier), bukan di storage vault, jadi storage redundancy vault tidak berlaku. Jadwalnya setiap 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, atau 12 jam, atau harian.
Untuk Azure Disk Backup, Backup vault dan disk harus di region yang sama, tapi boleh di subscription berbeda. Resource group snapshot harus di subscription yang sama dengan disk-nya.
Untuk Azure Disk Backup, managed identity Backup vault butuh role Disk Backup Reader di disk sumber dan Disk Snapshot Contributor di resource group snapshot.

Untuk backup app-consistent seluruh VM (virtual machine), restore file atau folder, atau restore ke region lain, pakai Azure VM backup. Azure Disk Backup cocok untuk backup beberapa kali sehari per disk tanpa agen dan tanpa mengganggu aplikasi.

Backup blob punya dua tier. Operational backup bersifat kontinu, datanya tetap di storage account sumber, dan dipulihkan dengan point-in-time restore. Vaulted backup terjadwal dan menyalin data ke Backup vault, jadi melindungi juga dari terhapusnya storage account. Policy baru selalu menyertakan vaulted backup.
Backup blob, operational maupun vaulted, hanya untuk block blob di storage account standard general-purpose v2.
Untuk backup blob, managed identity Backup vault butuh role Storage Account Backup Contributor di storage account yang dilindungi.
